d: Short, messy, deep plum-purple hair with choppy bangs and a small cowlick. Sharp, narrow lime-green eyes with a mischievous expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender, petite build dressed in a green and olive-toned hooded tunic with wide sleeves featuring a white and red jagged pattern, layered over dark teal leggings and white footwear. The ensemble is accented by gold metallic trim, a gold belt, and a large, ornate golden polearm with a crescent-shaped blade.
